lines.text: Every full moon they danced under me. Then the last dance, and the doors closed.
lines.script: [dreamy, slow] Every full moon they danced under me. [heavy, sighing] Then the last dance, and the doors closed.
[grand, languid] From the top! [poised, bright] Round two!
[grand, languid] Round 2. [wistful, poised] The band plays on.
[grand, languid] Round 3. [wistful, poised] The band plays on.
[grand, weary] Round 4. [wistful, languid] The band plays on.
[grand, weary] Round 5. [wistful, poised] The band plays on.
[faint, breathy] ...one more song. [hushed, pleading] Just one.

lines.text: They said see you next moon. 1971.
lines.script: [soft, aching] They said see you next moon. [fading, fond] 1971.

lines.speaker: The Mirrorball
lines.text: ...You asked me. Three times. Nobody has asked me to dance since 1971.
lines.script: [slow, stunned] ...You asked me. [languid, disbelieving] Three times. [aching, soft] Nobody has asked me to dance since 1971.

lines.speaker: The Mirrorball
lines.text: I don't need the moon. I just needed somebody to ASK.
lines.script: [haughty, quietly broken] I don't need the moon. [tender, lingering] I just needed somebody to ASK.
